# Ingrid Martinez Martins

> Data analyst with 12 years of B2B commercial experience (industrial sales, FMCG, SaaS),
> now building the models, dashboards and applications behind commercial decisions.
> Based in Kilkenny, Ireland. Authorised to work in Ireland (Stamp 1G).
> Native Portuguese, advanced English.

## Positioning

Ingrid is a commercial-data hybrid: someone who spent 12 years carrying a sales
number and now builds the analytics that explain it. She is not a career-switcher
starting from zero — the domain knowledge (funnel, portfolio, churn, conversion,
account management) predates the technical layer.

Open to: Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, Sales Analytics,
Customer Success Operations, and technical commercial roles. Ireland or remote.

## Verified proof points

- Cobli (Key Account Manager, SaaS, 2022-2023): around 30 commercial proposals,
  11 strategic accounts under management, R$200k+ in closed contracts in 7 months,
  in a long sales cycle.
- Gerdau (Sales Specialist, 2019-2022): portfolio of around 80 accounts per month,
  R$800k in average monthly revenue, delinquency reduced to a 5% to 15% range.
- Lacrei Saúde front-end challenge: Lighthouse 100 accessibility, 97 performance,
  WCAG AA contrast, with direct feedback from the founder.
- 7 years at Gerdau (industrial steel), across operations analysis (2015-2019) and
  direct sales (2019-2022).
- Co-founded Viver Natura (2017-2020), launching two retail stores alongside Gerdau.
- Google Student Ambassador 2026.

## Skills

Data: Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, Power BI, DAX, Excel, ETL, machine learning,
churn prediction, RFM segmentation, K-Means clustering, regression / sales forecasting.

Engineering: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Jest / React Testing
Library, web accessibility (WCAG).

Commercial: key account management, B2B sales, long sales cycles, upsell / cross-sell,
proposal writing, pipeline and portfolio management.
